patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution photography and video are used as dominant visual elements, often serving as entire section backgrounds or hero content.
Consistent use of a refined sans-serif typeface, frequently in uppercase with generous letter-spacing for navigation, labels, and calls to action, conveying elegance.
A minimalist palette of black and white provides a clean canvas, allowing the rich, natural, and often metallic tones within the product photography to be the primary source of color.
The hero video/image exhibits a subtle parallax or zoom effect on scroll, creating a sense of depth and movement as the user navigates the page.
The main navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay to a solid black sticky bar with a reduced height after an initial scroll, maintaining brand presence.
Major content blocks are introduced by full-width, high-impact photographic or video backgrounds, creating distinct visual chapters on the page.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely orchestrated by `locomotive-scroll`, which enables sophisticated scroll-triggered animations. The hero video/image utilizes this to create a subtle parallax or zoom effect as the user scrolls, enhancing immersion. Subsequent content sections appear to reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport. The main navigation bar transitions dynamically, shrinking in height and gaining a solid black background to become sticky after the initial scroll depth, ensuring it remains visible and functional.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, slightly condensed sans-serif with headings being moderately larger than body text, often using uppercase and generous letter-spacing for a refined feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal to no visible corner rounding on elements, reinforcing a precise and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in hero sections and between major content blocks, contributing to a luxurious and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its bold and artistic use of full-bleed, high-quality photography and video as the primary content and section dividers, creating an immersive and editorial experience. This visual dominance, combined with a minimalist interface and subtle scroll-triggered motion, elevates the product presentation beyond a typical e-commerce grid, focusing on brand storytelling and aesthetic appeal.
